options.content:
**What you see:** every **Nouvelair** plane flying right now between Tunisia and Europe, updated every minute.

**Where the data comes from:** aircraft broadcast their position by radio (called **ADS-B**).
Thousands of volunteers run small receivers that pick up these signals and share them through
**adsb.lol**, a free public flight-tracking network. Our pipeline asks adsb.lol every 60 seconds
for planes over Tunisia and Europe, keeps the Nouvelair ones (flight numbers starting with **LBT**),
adds the route (e.g. *Paris → Tunis*), sends them through **Kafka** and checks their quality.

**The rows below** answer five questions about the data: *Is enough arriving? Is it recent?
Is its format correct? Do the values look normal? Does everything make it through the pipeline?*
Times are shown in your browser's time zone. *Estimated arrival* is based on the straight-line
distance and current speed, so treat it as an approximation.

panels.title: Data age (95% under)
panels.description: How old a plane position is when we process it. 95% of positions are newer than this.

panels.title: Messages delivered
panels.description: Messages received by the quality checker / messages sent to Kafka.

panels.title: 1 · Volume: are we receiving as much data as usual?
Flights tracked: today vs. yesterday
panels.description: Nouvelair has a daily rhythm (quiet at night, busy in the morning). Yesterday is the baseline; a big gap means a problem.

panels.title: Planes seen by the tracking network
panels.description: All aircraft adsb.lol reports over our areas, and how many are Nouvelair. If 'all airlines' drops, the source has a problem, not Nouvelair.

panels.title: 2 · Freshness: how recent is the data?
Data age when processed
panels.description: Time between the plane sending its position and our pipeline processing it. Mostly the 60 s polling interval.

panels.title: Where the time goes (95th percentile)
panels.description: source_to_api: radio receiver → adsb.lol · api_to_kafka: our producer · kafka_to_consumer: Kafka → quality checker.

panels.title: Time since last data pull
panels.description: Should stay around 60 s. Above 5 minutes the 'PipelineStalled' alert fires.

panels.title: 3 · Schema: is the data in the expected format?
Rejected messages by reason
panels.description: e.g. missing_position: the plane was heard but without coordinates.

panels.title: Fields per plane record (min / max)
panels.description: Different transponders send different fields, so some variation is normal. A sudden jump means adsb.lol changed its format.

panels.title: Flights with unknown route
panels.description: Flight numbers missing from our route list (data/routes.csv). If this grows, refresh it with 'make routes'.

panels.title: 4 · Distribution: do the values look normal?
Altitude of positions (last 24h)
panels.description: Most positions should be at cruising altitude (30,000–40,000 ft).

panels.title: 5 · Lineage: where does the data come from, and does it all arrive?
Requests to adsb.lol by area
panels.description: Status 200 = OK. Anything else (or 'error') means adsb.lol did not answer correctly.
